scope: Clinical/repository metadata only. No gene abundance, expression matrix, pathway score or expression-outcome association was read or computed.
source_boundary: Independent recomputation from public ENA/NCBI repository metadata and the previously audited, deduplicated Source Data clinical export. The original workbook extraction and clinical response adjudication were not repeated.

endpoints.definition: Study-defined clinical benefit is confirmed CR/PR OR stable disease maintained at least six months. The six-month requirement applies to stable disease, not to every response or all five benefit cases. Objective-response labels represent confirmed CR/PR; the reported trial had PRs and no CRs.
endpoints.label_source: Author-labelled RESPONDER and CLINICAL BENEFIT columns in the original trial Source Data, accessed here through the previously audited deduplicated clinical export whose hash is recorded above.
endpoints.durability_boundary: The deduplicated clinical table supplies author-classified RESPONDER and CLINICAL BENEFIT labels, not visit-level response measurements or stable-disease duration. The three benefit/nonresponse cases are durable SD under the stated source definition; this review does not independently re-adjudicate their duration from individual scans.

collection_timing.interpretation: Intervals are from screening-labelled specimen collection to on-treatment specimen collection, not to first drug dose. The 23 intervals above 90 days support predominantly archival sampling, with one later Cycle5 biopsy; exact pretreatment specimen age is not supplied. Biopsy organ cannot be inferred from primary site or metastatic-site lists.

confounding_limits: Both objective responders received 200 mg BID and lacked liver in the supplied site lists; ORR cannot separate response association from these clinical features.

Clinical benefit is also imbalanced by dose and liver status (3/5 at 200 mg; 4/5 without liver), supporting the already specified descriptive/stratified sensitivities rather than outcome-driven exclusions.
TMB is missing for one benefit case; both groups contain TMB variation and the nonbenefit range reaches 74.02. The responder value25.55 should not be presented as the only high-TMB observation.
Unknown biopsy organ, archival timing, tissue composition/purity and incompletely characterized technical batch prevent a fully adjusted causal biomarker interpretation.
Public 28-patient paired RNA inventory is distinct from the 34-patient peer-review exploratory analysis; their identity/inclusion mapping remains unavailable.
publication_content: Aggregate metadata and audit boundaries only; no subject-labelled rows are emitted in this receipt.
projection_note: Aggregate linkage, endpoint, missingness and timing/confounding review; no clinical subject rows or outcome-labelled expression.
